expected_heading: Unauthorized Use or Imitation of System Functionality
section: Unauthorized Use or Imitation of System Functionality
paraphrase: Nothing in the app or its ads may mimic or interfere with system notifications or warnings; system notifications may carry only the app's own integral features, never ads for another app or service, and must be clearly attributed to the app.
